acceptance: The same frozen binary runs OFF and ON arms under glm_safe_run.sh containment.
Both sequential requests start at position zero and produce byte-identical OFF/ON token IDs and generated bytes.
The ON arm has exactly request IDs 1 and 2, layers 4 through 78, contiguous indexed chunks, and five uniquely named artifacts per request/layer/chunk.
Every request/layer/chunk log event matches its files; no legacy-format corpus file, duplicate, gap, trace error, non-finite value, invalid expert ID, or scorer failure is accepted.
At least 76800 token-layer events are captured with zero dropped events.
Both arms exit cleanly with no OOM, Xid, swap growth, cgroup event, timeout, or surviving server, and at least 10 GiB memory remains available.
note: This freezes a bounded corpus-capture smoke, not the one-million-event P0 corpus or a serving-performance candidate.
